tasks.title: Setup Test Infrastructure Foundation
tasks.description: Establish the foundational test infrastructure including directory structure, Docker configuration, and basic CI/CD pipeline setup for the comprehensive testing framework.
tasks.details: Create the test directory structure (tests/integration/, tests/e2e/, tests/fixtures/, tests/utils/). Set up Docker containers for isolated test environments. Configure GitHub Actions workflow files for CI/CD integration. Implement basic test environment provisioning scripts using Terraform modules. Create configuration templates for multi-cloud provider support (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI). Set up secrets management for cloud provider credentials and Aviatrix controller access.
tasks.testStrategy: Validate directory structure creation, verify Docker container builds successfully, test GitHub Actions workflow triggers, confirm Terraform modules can provision basic test infrastructure, validate secrets are properly encrypted and accessible.

tasks.title: Implement Test Environment Management
tasks.description: Create automated test environment provisioning and cleanup systems for containerized, multi-cloud test environments with isolated Terraform state management.
tasks.details: Develop Docker-based isolated test environments with pre-configured Aviatrix controllers. Create Terraform modules for AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI test infrastructure provisioning. Implement automated resource cleanup mechanisms using Terraform destroy and cloud provider APIs. Set up isolated Terraform state management with unique state files per test execution. Configure environment health checks and monitoring. Implement environment pooling for parallel test execution.
tasks.testStrategy: Test environment provisioning across all cloud providers, validate resource cleanup completeness, verify state isolation between concurrent tests, confirm environment health checks work correctly, test parallel environment creation and destruction.

tasks.title: Develop Integration Test Framework for Resources
tasks.description: Create a comprehensive integration testing framework for all 282 Terraform resources with CRUD operations, dependency testing, and error handling validation.
tasks.details: Implement test generators for CRUD operations (Create, Read, Update, Delete) using Terraform Plugin SDK v2 testing framework. Create resource dependency testing utilities to validate resource relationships and chains. Develop error handling test cases for negative scenarios and edge cases. Implement Terraform import functionality testing for all resources. Create state management tests for drift detection and correction. Build test data generators for synthetic test data creation. Implement test fixtures and configuration templates for consistent testing.
tasks.testStrategy: Validate CRUD operations for sample resources, test dependency chains with known resource relationships, verify error handling for invalid configurations, confirm import functionality works correctly, test state drift detection and correction scenarios.

tasks.title: Implement Data Source Integration Tests
tasks.description: Create comprehensive integration tests for all 46 data sources including data retrieval validation, performance testing, and error handling scenarios.
tasks.details: Develop data source query testing framework using Terraform Plugin SDK v2. Implement data retrieval validation with filters and query parameters. Create performance testing for data source response times with benchmarking. Build dependency testing between data sources and related resources. Implement error handling tests for invalid queries and missing resources. Create test utilities for data source configuration generation and validation.
tasks.testStrategy: Test data retrieval for sample data sources, validate query filters and parameters work correctly, measure and benchmark response times, test error scenarios with invalid queries, verify data source dependencies function properly.

tasks.title: Build Cross-Resource Testing Framework
tasks.description: Implement testing framework for complex multi-resource scenarios, resource relationships, and cross-resource state consistency validation.
tasks.details: Create multi-resource dependency chain testing using resource.TestCase with complex configurations. Implement resource relationship validation across different resource types. Build configuration validation for complex multi-resource Terraform configurations. Create state consistency tests for cross-resource scenarios. Implement test scenarios for resource interdependencies and cascading updates. Develop utilities for managing complex test configurations and state validation.
tasks.testStrategy: Test multi-resource dependency chains with known relationships, validate complex configurations deploy successfully, verify state consistency across related resources, test cascading updates and their effects on dependent resources.

tasks.title: Develop End-to-End Workflow Testing
tasks.description: Create comprehensive end-to-end testing framework for real-world Aviatrix network deployment scenarios and complete workflow validation.
tasks.details: Implement complete network deployment scenarios using full Aviatrix topology configurations. Create multi-cloud connectivity testing scenarios across AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI. Develop gateway lifecycle testing including creation, configuration, updates, and teardown. Implement security and routing policy application testing. Create disaster recovery and backup scenario testing. Build enterprise deployment simulation with large-scale network configurations. Implement hybrid cloud and multi-region deployment testing.
tasks.testStrategy: Deploy complete network topologies and validate connectivity, test multi-cloud scenarios end-to-end, verify gateway lifecycles complete successfully, validate policy applications work correctly, test disaster recovery scenarios, confirm enterprise-scale deployments function properly.

tasks.title: Implement Performance and Load Testing
tasks.description: Create performance testing framework including load testing, concurrent operations, API rate limiting, and resource scaling validation with profiling capabilities.
tasks.details: Develop load testing framework for high-volume resource creation and deletion using Go testing with concurrent goroutines. Implement concurrent operations testing for parallel resource management scenarios. Create API rate limiting tests for Aviatrix controller API limits. Build resource scaling performance tests for large-scale deployments. Implement memory and CPU profiling for provider performance analysis using Go pprof. Create performance benchmarking and regression detection. Set up performance metrics collection and reporting.
tasks.testStrategy: Execute load tests with high resource volumes, test concurrent operations under stress, validate API rate limiting behavior, measure performance of large-scale deployments, profile memory and CPU usage, compare performance benchmarks against baselines.

tasks.title: Build CI/CD Pipeline Integration
tasks.description: Implement comprehensive CI/CD integration with GitHub Actions including matrix testing, conditional execution, and automated reporting.
tasks.details: Configure GitHub Actions workflows for automated test execution on PR and merge events. Implement matrix testing for parallel execution across multiple cloud providers and environments. Create conditional testing logic based on changed files and smart test selection. Build comprehensive test reporting with coverage metrics and failure diagnostics. Implement artifact management for test logs, state files, and failure artifacts. Create test result dashboards and notifications. Set up automated test environment provisioning within CI/CD pipeline.
tasks.testStrategy: Validate GitHub Actions workflows trigger correctly, test matrix execution across cloud providers, verify conditional test selection works properly, confirm test reports generate accurately, validate artifact collection and storage, test notification systems.

tasks.title: Implement Test Coverage and Monitoring
tasks.description: Create comprehensive test coverage tracking, monitoring dashboard, and alerting system for test execution metrics and quality gates.
tasks.details: Implement test coverage tracking for all 282 resources and 46 data sources using Go coverage tools. Create monitoring dashboard for test execution metrics, success rates, and failure patterns. Build alerting system for test failures, performance degradation, and coverage gaps. Implement quality gates with minimum 95% line coverage per resource and maximum 1% flaky test rate. Create automated coverage reporting and trend analysis. Set up performance monitoring for test execution times and resource usage.
tasks.testStrategy: Validate coverage tracking accurately measures test coverage, verify monitoring dashboard displays correct metrics, test alerting system triggers appropriately, confirm quality gates enforce coverage requirements, validate performance monitoring captures execution metrics.

tasks.title: Create Documentation and Training Materials
tasks.description: Develop comprehensive documentation, runbooks, and training materials for the testing framework including usage guides and maintenance procedures.
tasks.details: Create comprehensive testing framework documentation including architecture overview, usage guides, and API references. Develop runbooks for test execution, troubleshooting, and maintenance procedures. Build training materials for team onboarding including video tutorials and hands-on exercises. Create contribution guidelines for adding new tests and maintaining existing ones. Document test environment setup and configuration procedures. Create troubleshooting guides for common issues and failure scenarios. Implement automated documentation generation where possible.
tasks.testStrategy: Review documentation for completeness and accuracy, validate runbooks by following procedures step-by-step, test training materials with team members, verify contribution guidelines are clear and actionable, confirm troubleshooting guides resolve common issues.
